description: Yearly IRNR of a non-resident owner of a Spanish home: imputed income (1.1 % or 2 % of the cadastral value for days not let) and rental income (EU/EEA: 19 % net of expenses; others: 24 % on gross rent). Every line cites its law and check date; rules pending validation (RDL 29/2026) are listed, not applied. An estimate, not tax advice.

cadastral_value_eur.description: Valor catastral of the property (IBI receipt), whole euros.

days_let.description: Days let in the tax year (owned all year; the previous calendar year, 365 or 366 days); required when rent_eur_year > 0.

eu_resident.description: Tax resident of another EU/EEA state with tax information exchange (19 %, expenses deductible) — else 24 % on gross rent.

expenses_eur_year.description: Deductible expenses linked to the letting (only EU/EEA residents may deduct them); default 0.

locale.description: Language of names and page links; default en.

rent_eur_year.description: Rent received in the year, whole euros; default 0.

revised.description: true if the cadastral value was revised in a general valuation in force in the tax year or the ten previous ones (1.1 % instead of 2 %, LIRPF art. 85.1). The RDL 29/2026 extension to revisions since 2012 is not in force yet: older revisions are false.

title: Spanish non-resident income tax (IRNR, modelo 210)
